title: The Stag in the Stream
summary: The stag admired his branching horns and despised his thin legs. When hounds chased him, his legs carried him away, but his antlers became caught in the thicket, leaving him to the...
full_text: The stag admired his branching horns and despised his thin legs. When hounds chased him, his legs carried him away, but his antlers became caught in the thicket, leaving him to the hunter.
moral: We often despise the useful legs that save us, and prize the antlers that bring ruin.
